title: New Budget is bounced back to the first budget instead of opening the created one
notes:
Pre-existing (same shell + MenuPanes code as syscd). NewBudgetPane dispatches switchBudget(created.id) before the Budgets list refetches; BudgetLayout's reconcile effect sees the id missing from the stale list and switches to budgets.data[0]. FreshStartPane awaits refetchBudgets first; NewBudgetPane does not. Traced via localStorage writes: new id, then aaaa...0002.
Fixed: New Budget refetches the list before switching and stays on the created budget, commit c7b0ffb, merged to main at 4c3532b; verified in the 5e regression pass (docs/decisions.md).
